name: All Natural and Certified Organic Farmers Market (HOPE farm)
tagline: HOPE for Small Farm Sustainability in Harlingen: Organic Farm Guide
description: All Natural and Certified Organic Farmers Market (HOPE farm) is a farmers market in 19833 Morris Rd Harlingen, TX, bringing together local growers, bakers, and makers. Shoppers can find seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from area farms. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
